name: IPC AI
rootCause: On 7 January 2025, the IPC AI token contract on BNB Chain was exploited for over $590,000 due to a flaw in its transfer and swap logic. The attacker bypassed flashloan protections and the token’s deflationary burn through direct low-level swaps, allowing repeated draining of the liquidity pool without being flagged by protective mechanisms. A faulty interaction between the IPC token's transfer logic and swap detection in its associated liquidity pool allowed direct swaps to bypass buy/sell classification, flashloan protection, and the token burn mechanism, enabling an attacker to repeatedly drain the pool.
